h2: Water Heater Repair & Installation Sanur – Quick Local Service
intro: No hot water in your Sanur villa? Water Heater Repair & Installation Sanur is what I do every week — electric tanks, gas units, rooftop solar coils, all of it. Between salt air, brackish well water and pipework that has seen two decades of sun, heaters here fail faster than most people expect.

sections.h3: Why Heaters Struggle in Sanur's Coastal Air
sections.text: Sanur sits close enough to the Indian Ocean that salt-laden breeze settles on every outdoor component — pump motors, heater casings, exposed fittings. In Sindhu especially, corrosion shows up within a couple of seasons. Layer brackish well water that accelerates scale inside the tank onto PVC pipework that has gone brittle after fifteen or twenty years of UV exposure, and you get premature failure long before the unit should die. My first job is always separating an electrical fault from environmental wear.

sections.h3: The Jobs I See Most Around Mertasari
sections.text: Burned-out heating elements, thermostats drifting so the shower stays lukewarm, corroded joints weeping onto bathroom tile, breakers tripping each time the tank fires up — these are the calls that come through weekly. Rooftop solar setups that once delivered proper heat now struggle as mineral deposits choke the internal coil. New installations, whether swapping a tired gas unit for electric or adding a second tank for a guest bath, get scoped as one visit including any brittle pipe sections that need replacing alongside the heater itself.

sections.h3: What to Send Over WhatsApp Before I Quote
sections.text: A few clear photos do most of the talking: the front panel showing the brand plate, the area where dripping or rust is visible, and if readable, the model number on the back. Tell me whether it runs on electricity, gas, or rooftop solar; what exactly is happening (no heat at all, tripping, slow leak); and roughly how old the villa is. From those images I can usually tell whether this is a simple part swap or something larger, and give you a fair estimate before anyone lifts a wrench.

sections.h3: Prevention Habits That Save Money in Batujimbar
sections.text: Villas in Batujimbar sit close enough to the sea that salt spray reaches even covered patios during monsoon. Flush the tank every six months to knock out brackish-water sediment before it calcifies onto the element. Inspect the sacrificial anode rod annually and replace it the moment it looks eaten away — without it, the tank shell corrodes from the inside. Wipe down outdoor fittings with fresh water after heavy rain, and check PVC joints each dry season; UV-brittled pipe cracks silently and only announces itself through a slow drip under the bathroom floor at two in the morning.

faq.q: How long does a typical heater repair take?
faq.a: Most element or thermostat swaps are finished in one visit; if a specific part needs ordering from Denpasar, I'll confirm the timeline over WhatsApp once I've inspected the unit.

faq.q: Do you handle rooftop solar heaters as well?
faq.a: Yes — coil descaling, pump replacement, pressure checks, and full system diagnostics for solar setups are all part of what I cover across Sanur.

faq.q: Can you install a new heater where there was no hot water before?
faq.a: Absolutely. I run the pipework, wiring, and venting required, and if the existing PVC is past its prime I'll flag it so we can plan the whole job together rather than patching around a problem.
